overview: The Akhevan Dominion Front is the arcane war-front where Akhevan ritualists, shadow constructs, and dominion commanders push into the Umbral Plains.
history: The Front was established after the first planar fracture opened in the Plains.
Akhevan ritual pylons were erected to siphon void resonance.
Shadow constructs were deployed to overwhelm Vanguard fortifications.
Dominion commanders began void ascension experiments to weaponize planar bleed-through.
hooks: A void ascension chamber destabilizes, threatening planar collapse.
Shadow constructs breach the Vanguard Line.
Dominion ritualists attempt a mass resonance siphon.
A new Akhevan commander arrives to escalate the conflict.
